content:
**Stingwing Filet** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A cooked piece of Stingwing Meat that gives a 30 minute boost to Strength while restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Stingwing Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Stingwing Meat | | Stingwing Filet (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up Stingwing Meat for the first time.
- Chance to be sold by Responders vendors and Vendor Bot Resin as well as the raiders vendor at the Whitespring Resort.
